data.one_liner: Dart http middleware for HTTP Basic and Digest authentication
data.what_it_does: Provides an http middleware wrapper that adds HTTP Basic and Digest authentication support to standard requests. It includes clients for BasicAuth, DigestAuth, and NegotiateAuth for automatic method detection.
use_when: You need to authenticate http requests using HTTP Basic authentication.
You need to authenticate http requests using HTTP Digest authentication.
You want automatic detection between Basic and Digest authentication protocols.
avoid_when: You are using OAuth2 or token-based authentication services instead of standard HTTP Basic/Digest.
You are using an alternative networking package that already manages authentication natively like dio.
strengths: Supports both HTTP Basic and Digest authentication out of the box.
Offers automatic protocol detection via NegotiateAuthClient.
Integrates directly with the standard http package.
weaknesses: Limited to HTTP Basic and Digest authentication methods.
Not documented for complex custom auth flows outside of Basic and Digest.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: A powerful HTTP client for Dart, which supports interceptors for handling auth tokens and custom workflows.

alternatives.name: oauth2
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your backend requires OAuth2 authorization flows instead of basic or digest credentials.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: The underlying core library if you prefer to implement custom authentication headers manually.
